about.title: From a business need to a working tool
about.p1: A CRM to structure, an internal tool to build, or a workflow to automate? We define the scope and deliverables before starting.
about.p2: On Miria.ai, I built chat flows, subscriptions and CRM workflows. My lead generation CRM and Attio Bridge also show how I connect data, interfaces and business tools.
about.p3: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python and PostgreSQL/Supabase. Remote work, with possible visits in Paris. Fixed-scope projects quoted after a first discussion.
